info.title: Kobe API
info.description: Team-scoped routes act on the session's active team (spec D9); send X-Kobe-Team on changes. Errors are `{code, message}`. Authentication is the Better Auth session cookie.

get.summary: List the viewer's threads (or a project's readable threads), newest first
get.description: Keyset pagination on (last_activity_at, id). Never Trash. Without `project_id`, pinned and archived threads are left out (`/v1/threads/pinned`, `/archived`, CE19). With `folder` (KOBE-534; not with `q` or `project_id`): a folder's live, unarchived threads the caller may read (own, or shared with them; the caller's pinned ones are in `/pinned?folder=`), or with `none` the caller's own unfiled threads. With `q`, full-text search (KOBE-33): web-search syntax (`"phrase"`, `-exclude`, `or`) over user/assistant messages (all terms in one message) and titles (plus fuzzy title matching), ranked by relevance with snippets; `cursor` is then a search cursor and `limit` is capped at 50. Reads Postgres only (never wakes a sandbox).

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active. Required on changes; must match.

200.description: A page of threads (`ThreadSearchPage` when `q` is given).

409.description: `no_active_team` or `team_mismatch` (stale tab), or a thread conflict.

503.description: `search_timeout`: the search exceeded its time limit.

post.summary: Create a thread in the active team, owned by the caller

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active. Required on changes; must match.

post.description: With `agent_id`, the thread pins the agent's current published version (D19). Suspended, archived and never-published agents answer 409 `agent_unavailable`. With `test: true` (needs `agent_id`, no project) it is a builder test thread (KOBE-85): it runs the agent's unpublished draft, needs the right to edit the agent (else 404 `agent_not_found`), and stays out of lists, search and Trash. With `project_id` the caller must be able to converse in the project (every reader, PR3); the first such conversation mounts the project in the caller's scratchspace (MT1). A project that is not mounted yet is refused 409 `too_many_mounts` (with `limit`) once the caller has the workspace's maximum of open projects (default 20, MT3).

404.description: `agent_not_found` or `project_not_found`.

get.summary: The thread's family: readable ancestors root first, siblings and forks
get.description: TL1, TL2 (KOBE-533): walks `forked_from_thread_id` up at most 20 generations; each sibling or fork list holds at most 50, newest activity first, with `siblings_more` / `forks_more` when cut. Only threads the viewer may read are named: a chain reaching one they cannot read stops with `root_hidden: true`; a purged ancestor is simply absent. The viewer's own threads in Trash carry `deleted_at`. Never wakes a sandbox.

post.summary: Send a message: starts a run, or queues it behind the thread's active run (D17)
post.description: Owner only. The run is created queued and starts at once when nothing is active and the thread is not interrupted; otherwise `queued` is true and it starts in order (Retry runs first). Follow it with `GET /v1/runs/{id}/events`. `parent_entry_id` branches from an entry (edit-and-regenerate); absent = the thread's leaf when the run starts. `mentions` (KOBE-223) lists the workspace paths the member picked with `@`: each must be a live file of the owner's synced workspace with no invisible, format or shell characters, and only its `@file(<path>)` marker in `content` is replaced by the absolute `/workspace/...` path before the run is stored; any other `@file(...)` text stays as written. Steering and editing a queued message take `mentions` the same way. `viewing_from_entry` (KOBE-467, a regenerate) names the prompt entry sent again: the server reuses the viewed-file path of the run that sent it and reads the file's current content (nothing when that run viewed none or the file is gone); not with `viewing` (400).

413.description: `message_too_large`: the files add up to more than one message may (403 `quota_exceeded`: no storage left).

422.description: `attachments_unavailable` (this site has no workspace storage) or `invalid_parent_entry` (`parent_entry_id` is a note from Kobe, not a message), or `invalid_mention` (a `mentions` path is outside `/workspace`, holds invisible, format or shell characters, or is not a file in the workspace).

429.description: `budget_exhausted`: no new runs at 100 % of a budget (D30).

post.summary: Stop: cancel the active run (Pi aborts), or delete a queued message (D17)
post.description: The run ends `cancelled` at once with `run.interrupted {reason: cancelled}`. Stopping the active run pauses the messages queued behind it (`queue_paused`) until the user resumes the queue or sends a new message; deleting a queued message does not pause. Idempotent for a cancelled run.

get.summary: How the thread's runs ended and how its approvals were decided
get.description: What the chat marks inline that the entry tree does not hold: runs that ended `interrupted` or `budget_stopped`, runs that started and were stopped (`cancelled`) or `failed` (with the server's message), decided approvals (outcome and cause only), skills used, moves to another project, and where the agent version changed between runs (on the first run on the new version). Newest 500 of each, oldest first; `truncated` says older ones were left out. Visible like the thread; approvals only to the run's user (a reader of a shared thread gets none). Reads Postgres only.

post.summary: Compact the thread's conversation now
post.description: The owner asks Pi to summarize the idle thread's older conversation (CE15), optionally with a one-line `focus` for the summary. Runs as a compaction run (one active run per thread, budgets and usage apply) in the owner's workspace, which is woken if needed; answers once Pi has written the summary, whose `compaction` entry is then in the thread's entries. Each error code has one fixed message.

post.summary: Make a branch current and carry a summary of the branch left
post.description: The owner switches the idle thread to `to_entry_id` and has Pi summarize the branch being left (CT11), optionally with a one-line `focus`. Runs as a branch summary run (one active run per thread, never queued; budgets and usage apply) in the owner's workspace, woken if needed; answers once Pi wrote the `branch_summary` entry, which is then the thread's leaf (`thread.updated.leaf_entry_id` on the run's stream). At most 20 summaries per thread; never automatic. Each error code has one fixed message.

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active; must match when sent.

200.description: Summarized: the summary entry is the new leaf.

404.description: `thread_not_found` (unknown, another user's or team's thread) or `entry_not_found` (`to_entry_id` is not a message of this thread).
